description: Header file defining the DownloadManagerImplementation class, which implements the IDownloadManager interface for managing downloads, including configuration, download info, and related methods.

classes.name: DownloadManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements the IDownloadManager interface, managing download tasks, configuration, and notifications.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.description: JSON configuration container for download directory and ID.

classes.name: DownloadInfo
classes.description: Represents individual download details, including URL, ID, retries, priority, and cancellation status.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Starts a download with specified URL and options, returning a download ID.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses an ongoing download by ID.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a paused download by ID.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing download by ID.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a downloaded file by file locator.

methods.name: Progress
methods.description: Reports download progress percentage for a given download ID.

methods.name: GetStorageDetails
methods.description: Retrieves storage quota and used space in KB.

methods.name: RateLimit
methods.description: Sets rate limit for a specific download.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for download events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the download manager with the service shell.

methods.name: downloaderRoutine
methods.description: Background thread routine for managing downloads.

methods.name: notifyDownloadStatus
methods.description: Notifies registered observers about download status changes.

methods.name: pickDownloadJob
methods.description: Selects the next download job from queues.

methods.name: nextRetryDuration
methods.description: Calculates exponential backoff duration for retries.

methods.name: getDownloadReason
methods.description: Converts download failure reasons to string descriptions.
